```{r libraries}
library(SpatialFeatureExperiment)
library(SummarizedExperiment)
library(Matrix)
library(decoupleR)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r configuration}
sfe_path <- project_path("Revision/Nan annotation/Data/Xenium sfe objects/Xenium sfe object/sfe_09032026.rds")
matrisome_path <- project_path("Revision/Nan annotation/Data/Hs_Matrisome_Masterlist_Naba.csv")
output_dir <- file.path(getwd(), "xenium_ec_ecm_score_outputs")
dir.create(output_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

ec_lv2_levels <- c(
  "ACKR1_EC",
  "ACTA2_EC",
  "cycling_EC",
  "EPC",
  "HEY1_EC",
  "lymphatic_EC"
)

score_levels <- c(
  "CoreMatrisome score",
  "Collagens score",
  "ECM Glycoproteins score",
  "Proteoglycans score"
)

score_labels <- c(
  "CoreMatrisome score" = "Core\nmatrisome",
  "Collagens score" = "Collagens",
  "ECM Glycoproteins score" = "ECM\nglycoproteins",
  "Proteoglycans score" = "Proteoglycans"
)

ec_colors <- c(
  "ACKR1_EC" = "#4C78A8",
  "ACTA2_EC" = "#E45756",
  "cycling_EC" = "#72B7B2",
  "EPC" = "#F58518",
  "HEY1_EC" = "#54A24B",
  "lymphatic_EC" = "#B279A2"
)

to_dgC <- function(x) {
  if (inherits(x, "dgCMatrix")) return(x)
  x <- as(x, "CsparseMatrix")
  as(x, "dgCMatrix")
}

rescale01 <- function(x) {
  rng <- range(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (!all(is.finite(rng)) || rng[1] == rng[2]) {
    return(rep(0.5, length(x)))
  }
  (x - rng[1]) / (rng[2] - rng[1])
}

format_p <- function(p_value) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(p_value) ~ "p = NA",
    p_value < 0.001 ~ "p < 0.001",
    TRUE ~ paste0("p = ", formatC(p_value, format = "f", digits = 3))
  )
}

save_plot_set <- function(plot, basename, width, height) {
  png_file <- file.path(output_dir, paste0(basename, ".png"))
  pdf_file <- file.path(output_dir, paste0(basename, ".pdf"))
  svg_file <- file.path(output_dir, paste0(basename, ".svg"))

  ggplot2::ggsave(png_file, plot, width = width, height = height, dpi = 300, bg = "white")

  grDevices::pdf(pdf_file, width = width, height = height, useDingbats = FALSE, bg = "white")
  print(plot)
  grDevices::dev.off()

  grDevices::svg(svg_file, width = width, height = height, bg = "white")
  print(plot)
  grDevices::dev.off()

  invisible(c(png_file, pdf_file, svg_file))
}
```

# Data And ECM Score Setup

```{r prepare_ec_data}
if (!exists("sfe")) {
  sfe <- readRDS(sfe_path)
}

if (!"lv2_anno_new" %in% colnames(SummarizedExperiment::colData(sfe))) {
  stop("The Xenium sfe object must contain lv2_anno_new.")
}

sfe_coldata <- as.data.frame(SummarizedExperiment::colData(sfe))
sample_col <- dplyr::case_when(
  "sample_id" %in% colnames(sfe_coldata) ~ "sample_id",
  "SampleId" %in% colnames(sfe_coldata) ~ "SampleId",
  "SampleID" %in% colnames(sfe_coldata) ~ "SampleID",
  TRUE ~ NA_character_
)

keep_ec <- !is.na(sfe_coldata[["lv2_anno_new"]]) &
  sfe_coldata[["lv2_anno_new"]] %in% ec_lv2_levels

sfe_ec <- sfe[, keep_ec]
sfe_ec$lv2_anno_new <- factor(as.character(sfe_ec$lv2_anno_new), levels = ec_lv2_levels)

ec_counts <- as.data.frame(table(lv2_anno_new = as.character(sfe_ec$lv2_anno_new))) %>%
  dplyr::filter(Freq > 0) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(lv2_anno_new = factor(lv2_anno_new, levels = ec_lv2_levels)) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(lv2_anno_new)

write.csv(ec_counts, file.path(output_dir, "xenium_ec_ecm_lv2_counts.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

kable(ec_counts)
```

```{r matrisome_network}
matrisome <- read.csv(matrisome_path, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

ecm_core <- matrisome %>%
  dplyr::filter(`Matrisome Division` == "Core matrisome") %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    source = `Matrisome Category`,
    target = `Gene Symbol`
  )

ecm_network <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  ecm_core,
  ecm_core %>% dplyr::transmute(source = "CoreMatrisome", target = target)
) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(source, target)

gene_universe <- rownames(sfe_ec)

gene_availability <- ecm_network %>%
  dplyr::group_by(source) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_genes = dplyr::n_distinct(target),
    n_detected = sum(unique(target) %in% gene_universe),
    detected_fraction = n_detected / n_genes,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(score = paste0(source, " score")) %>%
  dplyr::filter(score %in% score_levels) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(score = factor(score, levels = score_levels)) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(score)

write.csv(gene_availability, file.path(output_dir, "xenium_ec_ecm_gene_availability.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

kable(gene_availability, digits = 3)
```

```{r run_ecm_aucell}
score_cache <- file.path(output_dir, "xenium_ec_ecm_aucell_scores.rds")

if (file.exists(score_cache)) {
  ecm_scores <- readRDS(score_cache)
} else {
  expr_mat <- to_dgC(SummarizedExperiment::assay(sfe_ec, "logcounts"))

  ecm_scores <- decoupleR::run_aucell(
    mat = expr_mat,
    network = ecm_network,
    minsize = 0,
    .source = source,
    .target = target,
    nproc = 1
  )

  saveRDS(ecm_scores, score_cache)
}
```

```{r score_tables}
ec_meta <- as.data.frame(SummarizedExperiment::colData(sfe_ec))
ec_meta$cell <- colnames(sfe_ec)
ec_meta$sample_id <- if (!is.na(sample_col) && sample_col %in% colnames(ec_meta)) {
  as.character(ec_meta[[sample_col]])
} else {
  NA_character_
}

score_long <- ecm_scores %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    score_name = paste0(source, " score"),
    cell = as.character(condition),
    score = as.numeric(score)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(score_name %in% score_levels) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    ec_meta %>%
      dplyr::transmute(
        cell,
        sample_id,
        lv2_anno_new = as.character(lv2_anno_new)
      ),
    by = "cell"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(lv2_anno_new), lv2_anno_new %in% ec_lv2_levels) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    score_name = factor(score_name, levels = score_levels),
    lv2_anno_new = factor(lv2_anno_new, levels = ec_lv2_levels)
  )

score_summary <- score_long %>%
  dplyr::group_by(score_name, lv2_anno_new) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_cells = dplyr::n(),
    n_samples = dplyr::n_distinct(sample_id[!is.na(sample_id) & sample_id != ""]),
    mean_score = mean(score, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_score = median(score, na.rm = TRUE),
    q25 = stats::quantile(score, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    q75 = stats::quantile(score, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_score = stats::sd(score, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_score = sd_score / sqrt(n_cells),
    ci95 = 1.96 * se_score,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

sample_summary <- score_long %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(sample_id), sample_id != "") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(sample_id, score_name, lv2_anno_new) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_cells = dplyr::n(),
    mean_score = mean(score, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_score = median(score, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

single_cell_kruskal <- score_long %>%
  dplyr::group_by(score_name) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_groups = dplyr::n_distinct(lv2_anno_new),
    p_value = stats::kruskal.test(score ~ lv2_anno_new)$p.value,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    p_adjust_bh = stats::p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"),
    p_label = format_p(p_adjust_bh)
  )

acta2_pairwise_tests <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(levels(score_long$score_name), function(cur_score) {
  dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(setdiff(ec_lv2_levels, "ACTA2_EC"), function(cur_group) {
    cur_df <- score_long %>%
      dplyr::filter(score_name == cur_score, lv2_anno_new %in% c("ACTA2_EC", cur_group)) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(compare_group = factor(as.character(lv2_anno_new), levels = c(cur_group, "ACTA2_EC")))

    if (dplyr::n_distinct(cur_df$compare_group) < 2) {
      return(data.frame())
    }

    data.frame(
      score_name = cur_score,
      comparison = paste0("ACTA2_EC vs ", cur_group),
      n_reference = sum(cur_df$compare_group == cur_group),
      n_acta2 = sum(cur_df$compare_group == "ACTA2_EC"),
      median_reference = median(cur_df$score[cur_df$compare_group == cur_group], na.rm = TRUE),
      median_acta2 = median(cur_df$score[cur_df$compare_group == "ACTA2_EC"], na.rm = TRUE),
      difference_median_acta2_minus_reference =
        median(cur_df$score[cur_df$compare_group == "ACTA2_EC"], na.rm = TRUE) -
        median(cur_df$score[cur_df$compare_group == cur_group], na.rm = TRUE),
      p_value = stats::wilcox.test(score ~ compare_group, data = cur_df, exact = FALSE)$p.value,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }))
})) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(score_name) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    p_adjust_bh = stats::p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"),
    p_label = format_p(p_adjust_bh)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

write.csv(score_long, file.path(output_dir, "xenium_ec_ecm_cell_scores.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(score_summary, file.path(output_dir, "xenium_ec_ecm_lv2_summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(sample_summary, file.path(output_dir, "xenium_ec_ecm_sample_summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(single_cell_kruskal, file.path(output_dir, "xenium_ec_ecm_single_cell_kruskal_tests.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(acta2_pairwise_tests, file.path(output_dir, "xenium_ec_ecm_acta2_pairwise_wilcox_tests.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

The tests above are exploratory single-cell distribution tests. They do not
model sample nesting, so the effect sizes and plots should carry more weight
than the p values.

# Mean ECM Scores

```{r dotplots, fig.width=8.2, fig.height=4.6}
make_ecm_dotplot <- function(summary_df, scale_by_score = FALSE) {
  plot_df <- summary_df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      score_name = factor(as.character(score_name), levels = rev(score_levels)),
      lv2_anno_new = factor(as.character(lv2_anno_new), levels = ec_lv2_levels)
    )

  if (isTRUE(scale_by_score)) {
    plot_df <- plot_df %>%
      dplyr::group_by(score_name) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        fill_score = rescale01(mean_score),
        size_score = fill_score
      ) %>%
      dplyr::ungroup()
    legend_title <- "Score-scaled mean"
    plot_title <- "EC ECM scores across Xenium EC annotations, scaled"
  } else {
    plot_df <- plot_df %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        fill_score = mean_score,
        size_score = rescale01(mean_score)
      )
    legend_title <- "Mean AUCell score"
    plot_title <- "EC ECM scores across Xenium EC annotations"
  }

  ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = lv2_anno_new, y = score_name)) +
    geom_point(
      aes(fill = fill_score, size = size_score),
      shape = 21,
      color = "grey35",
      stroke = 0.35
    ) +
    scale_y_discrete(labels = score_labels) +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "#D7301F", name = legend_title) +
    scale_size(range = c(4.5, 11.5), guide = "none") +
    labs(title = plot_title, x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", angle = 35, hjust = 1),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12.5, lineheight = 0.95),
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 10.5),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey88"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 15.5, hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 6)),
      plot.margin = margin(5.5, 6, 5.5, 5.5)
    )
}

p_dot_raw <- make_ecm_dotplot(score_summary, scale_by_score = FALSE)
p_dot_scaled <- make_ecm_dotplot(score_summary, scale_by_score = TRUE)

save_plot_set(p_dot_raw, "xenium_ec_ecm_dotplot_raw", width = 8.2, height = 4.6)
save_plot_set(p_dot_scaled, "xenium_ec_ecm_dotplot_score_scaled", width = 8.2, height = 4.6)

p_dot_raw
p_dot_scaled
```

```{r heatmaps, fig.width=8.2, fig.height=4.8}
    plot.title = element_text(size = 15.5, hjust = 0.5)

p_heatmap_scaled <- ggplot(heatmap_scaled_df, aes(x = lv2_anno_new, y = score_name, fill = mean_z)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.7) +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = score_labels) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#3B6FB6", mid = "white", high = "#D7301F", midpoint = 0, name = "Row z") +
  labs(title = "Mean EC ECM AUCell scores, row-scaled", x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", angle = 35, hjust = 1),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12.5, lineheight = 0.95),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 15.5, hjust = 0.5)
  )

save_plot_set(p_heatmap_raw, "xenium_ec_ecm_heatmap_raw", width = 8.2, height = 4.8)
save_plot_set(p_heatmap_scaled, "xenium_ec_ecm_heatmap_row_scaled", width = 8.2, height = 4.8)
```

# Cell-Level Distributions

```{r distribution_plots, fig.width=10, fig.height=6.8}
p_violin <- score_long %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    score_name = factor(as.character(score_name), levels = score_levels),
    lv2_anno_new = factor(as.character(lv2_anno_new), levels = ec_lv2_levels)
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = lv2_anno_new, y = score, fill = lv2_anno_new)) +
  geom_violin(width = 0.86, alpha = 0.72, color = "grey30", trim = TRUE) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, outlier.shape = NA, fill = "white", color = "grey15", linewidth = 0.4) +
  facet_wrap(~ score_name, ncol = 2, scales = "free_y", labeller = labeller(score_name = score_labels)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = ec_colors) +
  labs(title = "Single-cell EC ECM score distributions", x = NULL, y = "AUCell score", fill = NULL) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold", angle = 35, hjust = 1),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 12.5, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, hjust = 0.5)
  )

p_density <- score_long %>%
  dplyr::mutate(score_name = factor(as.character(score_name), levels = score_levels)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = score, color = lv2_anno_new, fill = lv2_anno_new)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.13, linewidth = 0.75, adjust = 1.05) +
  facet_wrap(~ score_name, ncol = 2, scales = "free", labeller = labeller(score_name = score_labels)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = ec_colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = ec_colors) +
  labs(title = "EC ECM score density by Xenium annotation", x = "AUCell score", y = "Density", color = NULL, fill = NULL) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(size = 12.5, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, hjust = 0.5)
  )

save_plot_set(p_violin, "xenium_ec_ecm_violin_box", width = 10, height = 6.8)
save_plot_set(p_density, "xenium_ec_ecm_density", width = 10, height = 6.8)

p_density
```

# Sample Means

```{r sample_mean_plot, fig.width=10, fig.height=6.4}
if (nrow(sample_summary) > 0) {
  p_sample <- sample_summary %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      score_name = factor(as.character(score_name), levels = score_levels),
      lv2_anno_new = factor(as.character(lv2_anno_new), levels = ec_lv2_levels)
    ) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = lv2_anno_new, y = mean_score, color = lv2_anno_new)) +
    geom_point(aes(size = n_cells), alpha = 0.82, position = position_jitter(width = 0.09, height = 0)) +
    facet_wrap(~ score_name, ncol = 2, scales = "free_y", labeller = labeller(score_name = score_labels)) +
    scale_color_manual(values = ec_colors) +
    scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 6), name = "Cells per sample") +
    labs(title = "Sample-level EC ECM score means", x = NULL, y = "Mean AUCell score", color = NULL) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold", angle = 35, hjust = 1),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 12.5, face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "right",
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, hjust = 0.5)
    )

  save_plot_set(p_sample, "xenium_ec_ecm_sample_mean_dots", width = 10, height = 6.4)
  p_sample
} else {
  cat("No sample identifier was available for the EC subset.")
}
```
